http_port.name: HTTP port
http_port.description: Port of the helper's HTTP API. Client apps reach it by the helper's host name (4c7fee11-wifi-helper for the official repository) and need no pairing secret.

listen_address.name: Listen address (optional)
listen_address.description: Leave empty to listen only on Home Assistant's internal app network. Use 0.0.0.0 only to open packet capture to your LAN; it is then protected by the capture token.

capture_enabled.name: Packet capture
capture_enabled.description: Serve pcap files recorded by client apps and analyse them with tshark, for example from Wireshark on a Windows PC. Requires a capture token.

capture_token.name: Capture token
capture_token.description: Password for the capture endpoints, at least 16 printable characters without spaces. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.
